Replying to @madreynolds  Crochet Poncho Tutorial! ch even multiple of 8(12,14,16) R1: sc 5, ch 5, skip 3, sc 5, repeat until end R2: sc, shell (9 treble crochets) in chain space, sc, ch 2, skip 3, sc, repeat until end R3: ch 8, *in 4th treble crochet from previous round sc, sc in next 2 stitches, ch 3, double treble crochet in ch space, ch 3* repeat until halfway, in ch space, [double treble crochet, ch 3, double treble crochet] ch 3,  *in 4th treble crochet from previous round sc, sc in next 2 stitches, ch 3, double treble crochet in ch space, ch 3*, repeat until end of row, double treble crochet in first stitch, ch 3, slipstitch in 5th chain R4: slip stitch into ch space, *sc in ch before the first sc, sc 2, sc in ch, ch 5,* repeat until increase, sc into ch space, ch 5, *sc into ch before sc, sc 2, sc in ch, ch 5,* repeat until end of row, ch 5 R5: sc, shell (9 treble crochets) in chain space, sc, shell, ch 2, skip 3, sc, repeat until increase, shell, sc, shell, *sc, ch 2, skip 3, sc shell,* repeat until end  repeat until one repeat before you like the length ( I did 26) R27: no increase. ch 8, *in 4th treble crochet from previous round sc, sc in next 2 stitches, ch 3, double treble crochet in ch space, ch 3* repeat until end of row  repeat others rows like normal without an increase.  andddd done!! 💕now you can sc along the neckline if you want!
